tool.description: Infer TypeScript interface/type definitions from a pasted JSON object or array. Nested objects become their own interfaces; arrays of objects are merged so keys missing in some elements become optional (?) and differing types become unions (e.g. number | string). root_name names the top-level type (default 'Root'); export=true (default) prefixes 'export'. Returns the TypeScript source.

json.description: A JSON object or array sample to infer TypeScript types from.

root_name.description: Name for the top-level interface/type (PascalCased). Default 'Root'.
